verdict.rationale: Pulumi ships Neo, a built-in AI agent: you tell it what you need in plain English, and it handles dependencies, executes changes and monitors outcomes, with enterprise controls built in. The MCP docs also explicitly mention delegating tasks to Pulumi Neo. All of this comes from vendor marketing and docs pages, with no hands-on or community confirmation. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of Neo's task-delegation workflow (scope, approvals, review of changes), independent or hands-on corroboration that delegation works as claimed.
